files.description: 131-page data dictionary for ModMed EMA EHI Export. Documents 197 database tables across 16 groupings (~4,800 columns) covering clinical, financial, and specialty eye-care data. Format: pipe-delimited CSV export with attachments folder. This is the primary and sole artifact from the registered URL.
Plain-text extraction of the PDF data dictionary (pdftotext, no layout). Used as input for the enrichment script.
Layout-preserved text extraction of the PDF data dictionary (pdftotext -layout). Preserves column positioning from the PDF table.

Bun TypeScript script that parses the pdftotext output into structured JSON. Two-pass parser: strips page artifacts, then uses a state machine to extract table definitions with groupings, descriptions, column names, and longitudinal tracking flags.

files.description: Structured JSON array of 197 table definitions extracted from the data dictionary PDF. Each entry has: grouping, table_name, description, columns[], longitudinal_tracking. This is the primary machine-queryable artifact.
